located_evidence.quote: The moratorium expires and this Resolution is automatically repealed at 12:01 a.m., local time, on July 1, 2027, or upon the earlier effective date of an ordinance amending the Zoning Regulations to regulate the construction, development, or operation of data centers.
This moratorium shall expire on August 25, 2026, unless otherwise extended by law.
This extension of the moratorium shall remain in effect for one (1) year and shall expire on August 25, 2027, unless sooner repealed, amended, or otherwise extended as authorized by law.
